items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: They all know me... they ask her... She said, yeah, I see Mr. Horace... Tell Mr. Horace I want him to be at the hall... I said, Dorothy? She said, what? I said, give me, number seven cents.

ctx.x: You want something? I say, no, I don't want nothing.

Well, y'all, y'all, y'all, you ain't got cigarettes? I say, no, I ain't got no cigarettes. Well, y'all, y'all, y'all, go best. Go get your pack of cigarettes. Well, now when they go play, now I might not see them before, I might not see them before next week or two weeks after. But they all, they all know me, you see. Now if they don't see me, they ask her, or they ask her little boy. Or say, uh, oh, Dorothy? Oh, Miss Horace? Says, uh, do you see, do you see Horace? She said, yes. I see, yeah, no. She said, yeah,…
